concerns.text: Task T020 describes checking 'unique_studies >= N' to decide on normalization. The spec (FR-010) and plan (FR/SC Mapping) explicitly mandate the threshold 'unique_studies >= N-1'. This off-by-one discrepancy means the task does not cover the functional requirement correctly, risking incorrect model training behavior.

Task T033 mentions updating the 'updated_at' timestamp to satisfy Constitution Principle V. However, Principle V also requires updating the content hash for artifacts. The task description is incomplete regarding the hash update requirement, leaving the versioning discipline only partially covered.

Task T014 implements the retention check for SC-001. The task description states the error message will be 'Retention below [deferred]'. The spec (SC-001) and plan require the pipeline to fail with error code E-DATA-INSUFFICIENT if retention < 80%. While the logic is present, the specific error code 'E-DATA-INSUFFICIENT' is not explicitly mandated in the task description, creating a potential gap in verification.
